content.title: Coachella 2026: see set and stage times, livestream schedule and how to watch
content.text: The 2026 edition of Coachella has officially kicked off, with performances on the way from Justin Bieber, Sabrina Carpenter and Karol G and more. Check out the details about the line-up, surprise guests, stage times and how to tune-in online below. This year the festival is back at its usual spot in the desert in Indio, California, and is happening across two weekends. The first weekend is set to take place from today Friday (April 10) through to Sunday (April 12), and the second will be on April 17, 18 and 19. As well as the aforementioned headliners, other acts slated to perform include The xx, Nine Inch Noize (Nine Inch Nails and Boys Noize), Disclosure, Turnstile, Ethel Cain, KATSEYE, The Strokes, Addison Rae, Labrinth, David Byrne, Interpol, Alex G, BIGBANG, Laufey, Iggy Pop, FKA Twigs, Wet Leg, Clipse and more. WATCH KNEECAP on their Trainspotting-inspired movie, with Irvine Welsh as a fan | Glastonbury 20240 seconds of 1 minute, 37 secondsVolume 0% Earlier this week, organisers finally revealed the set times for the first weekend, and also added Jack White to the bill as a last-minute surprise. He is set to perform tomorrow (Saturday April 11) and will be delivering a 45-minute set at the Mojave Tent at 3pm. A last minute, unexpected addition for the Saturday afternoon slot is becoming a tradition from Coachella organisers. Previously, both Ed Sheeran and Weezer – who like White, are usually festival headliners – were booked for a surprise slot on a Saturday afternoon. The announcement was made just days after White released the two new tracks on Friday – ‘G.O.D. And The Broken Ribs’ and ’Derecho Demonico’ – and played them live on SNL. Recommended Justin Bieber is predicted to play both of his ‘Swag’ albums in full, there is also the “bunker debut of Radiohead Kid A Mnesia” – a 75-minute large-format film made from thousands of fragments created by Thom Yorke and Stanley Donwood during the recording of ‘Kid A’. Lambrini Girls have also confirmed that they have pulled out of Coachella and had to reschedule their North American tour due to singer Phoebe Lunny sustaining a neck fracture and an “acute brain injury”. Check out the latest updates on the stage times, line-up and the livestream of performances below. When is Coachella 2026? The annual music bash kicked off today (Friday April 10) to the usual Empire Polo Club site in Indio, California. The location is set in the Coachella Valley in the Colorado Desert and will span across two weekends. This year, Coachella will run between April 10-12, and 17-19. Who’s playing Coachella 2026? The headliners for this year are Sabrina Carpenter, Karol G, and Justin Bieber. For the latter, the set comes on the heels of him releasing two surprise ‘Swag’ albums, and he is expected to play both in full during his set on Saturday. Nine Inch Nails will be joining forces with tour opener Boys Noize for a unique set under the name ‘Nine Inch Noize’, and other sets include a last minute appearance from Jack White, and performances from The Strokes, David Bryne, Turnstile, Geese, FKA Twigs and more. What are the stage times for Coachella weekend one 2026? Stage times for the first weekend were confirmed on Monday (April 6). This included Sabrina Carpenter taking to the stage at 9:05pm until 10:35pm for her Friday headline set, followed by a midnight set from Anyma. Justin Bieber’s performance will kick off at 11:25pm on Saturday, and on the Sunday, Karol G will headline from 9:55pm before a closing set from Kaskade at 10:45pm. As usual, YouTube will be livestreaming the festival via the Coachella channel, and it was recently confirmed that the 2026 livestream will feature all seven stages and 4K resolution. Three of those stages – the Coachella, Outdoor Theatre and Sahara – can be viewed in 4k, while the Quasar stage can be seen both horizontally and vertically. You can also stream up to four performances at the same time in a 4×4 grid format and, alongside live concerts, Coachella TV will also be hosting archival footage. Festival highlights will also be available on demand. Has anyone dropped out of Coachella 2026? At the time of writing, only two artists have pulled out of the festival after being announced as part of the line-up. Solomun announced that he would be dropping out of the event as he needs to take time to recover from ear surgery. Lambrini Girls also pulled out of Coachella earlier this week due to frontwoman Phoebe Lunny sustaining a neck fracture and an “acute brain injury”. The appearance from FKA Twigs will take place as expected, and comes after she told fans last year that she was “devastated” to share that she would be backing out of both the 2025 festival and her US tour dates due to visa issues. How do I get tickets for Coachella 2026? Tickets for the 2026 edition of Coachella sold out less than a week after the line-up was shared in September. While no tickets are currently available now things have kicked off, you can visit here for any extra tickets that may become available for later dates. What performances will be livestreamed and when? Today’s (Friday April 10) performances that will be livestreamed include NewDad, CMAT and Holly Humberstone, who will be streamed from the Gobi stage at 4:45pm, 6:15pm and 8:25pm respectively. KATSEYE and Sexyy Red will be streamed from the Sahara stage at 8pm and 12:05am respectively, and on the Mojave Stgae there is Central Cee (5:30pm), DEVO (6:45pm), Moby (8:10pm), Ethel Cain (10:35pm) and Blood Orange (11:55pm). For the main stage, there is Teddy Swims from 5:30pm, The xx from 7pm, Sabrina Carpenter from 9:05pm, and Anyma Presents ÆDEN from 12am.
